title: Radio waves carry messages
summary: Guglielmo Marconi developed practical wireless telegraphy and in 1901 reported receiving a signal sent across the Atlantic.

notes.problem: Source: 1901 transatlantic reception had 'no independent confirmation' and 'considerable scepticism'; 1943 US Supreme Court 'essentially invalidated' his claim to have invented radio. Work moved to England in 1896 (Poldhu, Cornwall).
